description: R4-hist alpha tuning on the same 300 High train routes; their own transitions are excluded from the count table while tuning.

settings.formula: cost(a->b) = D(a,b) + alpha * scale * mult(a) * (-log P(b|a)); cost(zone->station) = D
settings.D: mean stop-to-stop travel time between zones (same zone matrix as R1)
settings.scale: median off-diagonal zone-to-zone D of the route
settings.P: (c + k) / sum over the route's other zones of (c + k); candidates are only the zones present in this route
settings.counts: consecutive distinct zones in driver order (station and zone-less stops dropped, repeats collapsed), plus station -> first zone; keyed by station and full zone ID
settings.backoff: if this station's counts over the candidates sum to < 5, add the counts pooled over all stations for the same zone-ID pair
settings.counts_from: 5462 train routes (all quality labels; = all 5762 train routes minus the 300 tuning routes)
